autostorage.events._resolve_geometry(target: autostorage.models.GradientRow | autostorage.models.HessianRow | autostorage.models.StationaryPointRow) → autostorage.models.GeometryRow | None#

Return the target’s geometry, resolving it via the session if unattached.

Setting only geometry_id leaves .geometry unpopulated until the ORM syncs it.

autostorage.events._recompute_geometry_stationary_validity(geometry: autostorage.models.GeometryRow, *, excluding: collections.abc.Iterable[autostorage.models.HessianRow] = ()) → None#

Recompute StationaryPointRow.is_valid for a geometry from its Hessians.

excluding skips Hessians pending deletion (still in geometry.hessians at before_flush time since the DELETE hasn’t been issued yet).

autostorage.events.revalidate_geometry_orders_on_insert_update(session: sqlmodel.Session, flush_context: Any, instances: Any) → None#

Recompute order consensus for a geometry when a Stationary/Hessian changes.

A session-level before_flush listener, not a per-instance before_insert/ before_update mapper event: the recompute below mutates sibling StationaryPointRows that may already be clean going into this flush, and a mapper event fires too late in the flush cycle for that mutation to be included — SQLAlchemy silently drops it (the “Attribute history events… will not result in database updates” warning) instead of writing it.

Recompute order consensus for a geometry when one of its Hessians is deleted.

(‘symbols’, ‘coordinates’)

autostorage.events.verify_geometry_immutable_fields(mapper: sqlalchemy.orm.Mapper, connection: sqlalchemy.engine.Connection, target: autostorage.models.GeometryRow) → None#

Reject changes to symbols/coordinates on an already-persisted geometry.

Otherwise an in-place edit could invalidate Gradient/Hessian shape checks already run against it.

autostorage.events.compute_geometry_hash(mapper: sqlalchemy.orm.Mapper, connection: sqlalchemy.engine.Connection, target: autostorage.models.GeometryRow) → None#

Populate geometry_hash from bit-identical geometry fields before saving.

Written via target.__dict__[...] + flag_modified, not target.geometry_hash = ...: Geometry’s validate_assignment=True pydantic config corrupts SQLAlchemy’s flush-time identity-key bookkeeping when a plain attribute assignment happens inside a mapper event, breaking every GeometryRow insert.

autostorage.events.compute_stage_members_hash(mapper: sqlalchemy.orm.Mapper, connection: sqlalchemy.engine.Connection, target: autostorage.models.StageRow) → None#

Populate members_hash from the stage’s member stationary points before saving.

Every member must already be persisted (have an .id) – the same precondition StageRow.query/find_or_create already assume when looking up an existing stage.

autostorage.events.verify_stage_ts_consistency(mapper: sqlalchemy.orm.Mapper, connection: sqlalchemy.engine.Connection, target: autostorage.models.StepRow) → None#

Verify is_ts agreement between a StepRow and its linked stages.

stage1/stage2 must not be transition-state stages. When stage_id_ts is set, the referenced stage must be one.
